ROLE-0208.name: Software Engineer
ROLE-0208.note: Software & SaaS variant: works on the vendor's own product, so deeper domain and larger context than a general software engineer.

ROLE-0209.name: Site Reliability Engineer

duties.duty: Write and review automation and tooling

ROLE-0209.note: Software & SaaS variant: owns customer-facing uptime, so higher autonomy and assurance than a general SRE.

ROLE-0291.name: Forward Deployed Engineer
ROLE-0291.note: Writes production code inside the customer estate. Higher data sensitivity than an in-house engineer because it operates on customer systems and data.

duties.duty: Draft discharge summaries and clinic letters
Summarise current literature for a case

Complete clinical coding and activity returns
Maintain nursing records and care plans
Explain care and answer patient questions
Manage patient flow and bed allocation in real time
Advise on case strategy and merits

ROLE-0078.name: Security Governance Risk and Compliance Analyst

duties.duty: Balance the grid in real time
Assess and act on a disclosure

ROLE-0156.name: Regulatory Affairs Specialist
ROLE-0156.note: Medical device variant: technical files and notified-body review, so heavier document tooling and drawing interpretation than the pharmaceutical role.

ROLE-0286.name: Agronomist
ROLE-0286.note: Holding the BASIS Certificate in Crop Protection has been a legal requirement since 1985 for anyone advising on or supplying plant protection products in the UK, and crop assurance schemes require advisers to sit on the BASIS Professional Register, so the domain, compliance and assurance requirements are set in law and by a register rather than inferred.
ROLE-0286.profile_source: researched: regulation and mandatory standards first, then professional bodies, then current job descriptions

ROLE-0288.name: Farm Operations Manager
ROLE-0288.note: Responsible for a productive and sustainable livestock business meeting animal welfare and environmental standards, and for keeping farm assurance, training and environmental records accurate.
ROLE-0288.profile_source: researched: regulation and mandatory standards first, then professional bodies, then current job descriptions
ROLE-0288.onet_analogue: Farmers, Ranchers, and Other Agricultural Managers

ROLE-0289.name: Food Safety Manager
ROLE-0289.note: A documented HACCP-based food safety management system is a legal requirement, and BRCGS adds an audited standard covering traceability, allergen management and corrective action that retailers require contractually. An undetected failure is a foodborne illness, which is why accuracy and assurance both sit in the top band.
ROLE-0289.profile_source: researched: regulation and mandatory standards first, then professional bodies, then current job descriptions

ROLE-0287.name: Livestock Manager
ROLE-0287.note: Animal medicine records must be kept and made available for inspection by the authority, and the role is audited under farm assurance schemes. Physical inspection of condition, hygiene and disease signs is a routine duty, which is what puts visual interpretation high.
ROLE-0287.profile_source: researched: regulation and mandatory standards first, then professional bodies, then current job descriptions
ROLE-0287.onet_analogue: Farmers, Ranchers, and Other Agricultural Managers

ROLE-0290.name: Processing Plant Manager
ROLE-0290.note: Enforces compliance with food safety regulation and workplace safety standards while coordinating quality assurance, maintenance and logistics against production targets, so a failed handoff stops a line.
ROLE-0290.profile_source: researched: regulation and mandatory standards first, then professional bodies, then current job descriptions

ROLE-0241.name: Aircraft Maintenance Planner
ROLE-0241.note: Continuing airworthiness sits under EASA Part-M and maintenance organisations under Part-145, which mandate approved procedures, qualified licensed personnel, documented compliance monitoring and a quality system. Deviation is not a preference, and the consequence of an undetected error is a safety event.
ROLE-0241.profile_source: researched: regulation and mandatory standards first, then professional bodies, then current job descriptions

ROLE-0244.name: Disruption Management Coordinator
ROLE-0244.note: Recovery coordination against a live schedule, over voice, where the value of a decision decays by the minute.
ROLE-0244.profile_source: researched: regulation and mandatory standards first, then professional bodies, then current job descriptions
ROLE-0244.onet_analogue: Dispatchers, Except Police, Fire, and Ambulance

ROLE-0239.name: Flight Operations Controller
ROLE-0239.note: ICAO Annex 6 permits operational control to be delegated only to the pilot-in-command and the flight operations officer, and Annex 1 sets the licence. The role is accountable for a flight operating safely and within airspace regulation until it lands: the most demanding profile in this set, and the only one high on speech as well.
ROLE-0239.profile_source: researched: regulation and mandatory standards first, then professional bodies, then current job descriptions

ROLE-0240.name: Ground Operations Manager
ROLE-0240.note: Oversees ramp servicing and turnaround so a flight departs safely and on time, managing staff performance and equipment inspection against a clock and a safety regime.
ROLE-0240.profile_source: researched: regulation and mandatory standards first, then professional bodies, then current job descriptions

ROLE-0242.name: Network Planning Analyst
ROLE-0242.note: Designs and optimises the route network: demand forecasting, aircraft assignment by range and load, slot constraints at congested airports, and route profitability, using scheduling optimisation software.
ROLE-0242.profile_source: researched: regulation and mandatory standards first, then professional bodies, then current job descriptions

ROLE-0243.name: Airline Revenue Manager
ROLE-0243.note: Continuously updates demand forecasts from booking trends, competitor pricing, capacity and macroeconomic indicators, and adjusts seat availability across fare classes. The technique itself is chosen and defended, which is what puts quantitative reasoning at the top band.
ROLE-0243.profile_source: researched: regulation and mandatory standards first, then professional bodies, then current job descriptions

ROLE-0229.name: Game Designer
ROLE-0229.note: Defines mechanics, progression and economy, balances difficulty curves against telemetry, and communicates the design through documentation, diagrams and visual mockups. Errors are rework, not harm.
ROLE-0229.profile_source: researched: regulation and mandatory standards first, then professional bodies, then current job descriptions

ROLE-0230.name: Game Developer
ROLE-0230.note: Builds and prototypes gameplay systems in engine, against an interdependent codebase, validating feel and pacing before release.
ROLE-0230.profile_source: researched: regulation and mandatory standards first, then professional bodies, then current job descriptions

ROLE-0231.name: Live Operations Manager
ROLE-0231.note: Runs the game after release: plans in-game events, monitors player data, handles live issues and server problems, and leads crisis management during an outage.
ROLE-0231.profile_source: researched: regulation and mandatory standards first, then professional bodies, then current job descriptions

ROLE-0233.name: Community Manager
ROLE-0233.note: The studio's public voice: newsletters, social channels, live streams and handling criticism, feeding player sentiment back to designers. The sources did not establish a cross-language requirement, so it is not scored as one.
ROLE-0233.profile_source: researched: regulation and mandatory standards first, then professional bodies, then current job descriptions

ROLE-0232.name: Trust and Safety Analyst
ROLE-0232.note: Reviews reports and takes enforcement action under platform policy, collecting and documenting evidence for regulatory enquiries and legal action, under online safety regimes including the DSA. Handles abuse reports and identity fraud, across image, voice and language.
ROLE-0232.profile_source: researched: regulation and mandatory standards first, then professional bodies, then current job descriptions

ROLE-0265.name: Research Data Manager
ROLE-0265.note: Builds and operates research data governance so practice is compliant with legal, ethical, contractual and funder requirements, including GDPR on sensitive data and FAIR principles in funder data management plans.
ROLE-0265.profile_source: researched: regulation and mandatory standards first, then professional bodies, then current job descriptions

ROLE-0262.name: Research Fellow
ROLE-0262.note: Conducts independent research leading to publication, applies for grants and fellowships, and mentors students. The work is defined by questions nobody has settled, which is the definition of the top band on intelligence, reasoning and domain.
ROLE-0262.profile_source: researched: regulation and mandatory standards first, then professional bodies, then current job descriptions

ROLE-0263.name: Research Development Manager
ROLE-0263.note: Develops and implements funding applications against funder rules, where the submission is a persuasive document that binds the institution.
ROLE-0263.profile_source: researched: regulation and mandatory standards first, then professional bodies, then current job descriptions

ROLE-0264.name: Student Administration Manager
ROLE-0264.note: Runs right-to-study checks for students subject to immigration control, monitors visa status, refusal, non-enrolment and non-completion rates, and prepares for audit. A record error is an immigration and sponsor licence consequence, not an inconvenience.
ROLE-0264.profile_source: researched: regulation and mandatory standards first, then professional bodies, then current job descriptions

ROLE-0261.name: Lecturer
ROLE-0261.note: Roughly 40 per cent teaching, 40 per cent research, 20 per cent administration: delivers lectures and seminars, sets, marks and moderates assessment, supervises projects and publishes. Live spoken delivery is the core mode, which is what puts speech at band four.
ROLE-0261.profile_source: researched: regulation and mandatory standards first, then professional bodies, then current job descriptions

ROLE-0280.name: Knowledge Manager
ROLE-0280.note: Organises and shares firm knowledge so the right material reaches the right team at the right time, across a large client corpus.
ROLE-0280.profile_source: researched: regulation and mandatory standards first, then professional bodies, then current job descriptions

ROLE-0279.name: Programme Delivery Consultant
ROLE-0279.note: Develops and manages scope, plan, risks, issues and dependencies, runs governance meetings and drives business readiness, answerable for delivery rather than for the recommendation.
ROLE-0279.profile_source: researched: regulation and mandatory standards first, then professional bodies, then current job descriptions

ROLE-0278.name: Research Analyst
ROLE-0278.note: Combines research, data analysis and interviews to establish what is known in a market and where the gaps are, which is the top band on research and synthesis.
ROLE-0278.profile_source: researched: regulation and mandatory standards first, then professional bodies, then current job descriptions
ROLE-0278.onet_analogue: Market Research Analysts and Marketing Specialists

ROLE-0276.name: Strategy Consultant
ROLE-0276.note: Structured recommendations to leadership for evidence-based decisions, on problems whose shape has to be worked out first, on material the client has not made public.
ROLE-0276.profile_source: researched: regulation and mandatory standards first, then professional bodies, then current job descriptions

ROLE-0277.name: Transformation Consultant
ROLE-0277.note: Guides change programmes through transformation and acts as the single point of contact for portfolio and programme managers.
ROLE-0277.profile_source: researched: regulation and mandatory standards first, then professional bodies, then current job descriptions

ROLE-0285.name: Facilities Manager
ROLE-0285.note: Owns the statutory compliance programme for fire safety, asbestos, legionella, fixed-wire and emergency lighting, ensuring testing, servicing, risk assessments and resulting actions are completed and recorded, now within the building safety regime.
ROLE-0285.profile_source: researched: regulation and mandatory standards first, then professional bodies, then current job descriptions

ROLE-0284.name: Leasing Manager
ROLE-0284.note: Researches applicant background, negotiates lease agreements and completes the paperwork, against occupancy and rate targets. The lease is a binding document, which is what puts writing at band four.
ROLE-0284.profile_source: researched: regulation and mandatory standards first, then professional bodies, then current job descriptions
ROLE-0284.onet_analogue: Property, Real Estate, and Community Association Managers

ROLE-0281.name: Property Asset Manager
ROLE-0281.note: Runs budgets, tracks income and expense and reports to landlords and investors, researching market trends and rates across an interdependent portfolio.
ROLE-0281.profile_source: researched: regulation and mandatory standards first, then professional bodies, then current job descriptions
ROLE-0281.onet_analogue: Property, Real Estate, and Community Association Managers

ROLE-0282.name: Property Manager
ROLE-0282.note: Annual gas safety inspection by a registered engineer, records kept and certificates issued to tenants within statutory windows, and deposit handling where non-compliance carries penalty damages of two to three times the deposit. Compliance here is law, not policy.
ROLE-0282.profile_source: researched: regulation and mandatory standards first, then professional bodies, then current job descriptions
ROLE-0282.onet_analogue: Property, Real Estate, and Community Association Managers

ROLE-0283.name: Valuation Surveyor
ROLE-0283.note: Red Book Global Standards are mandatory rules for RICS members, and a registered valuer joins the Valuer Registration Scheme and agrees to risk-based audit in which RICS reviews a sample of valuations, files and reports. Individual accountability with a registration consequence is the definition of the top assurance band.
ROLE-0283.profile_source: researched: regulation and mandatory standards first, then professional bodies, then current job descriptions
ROLE-0283.onet_analogue: Appraisers and Assessors of Real Estate

ROLE-0200.name: Renewable Asset Manager
ROLE-0200.note: Owns portfolio performance and availability against contracted terms, coordinating operations and reporting to owners and investors.
ROLE-0200.profile_source: researched: regulation and mandatory standards first, then professional bodies, then current job descriptions

ROLE-0199.name: Generation Forecasting Analyst
ROLE-0199.note: Develops and maintains demand and renewable generation forecasting models, and analyses the relationship between forecasts, forward markets, system prices and imbalance cost. An error is an imbalance charge within the settlement period, which is what puts latency and accuracy high.
ROLE-0199.profile_source: researched: regulation and mandatory standards first, then professional bodies, then current job descriptions

ROLE-0198.name: Grid Connection Engineer
ROLE-0198.note: Grid code compliance is mandatory for grid-connected generation, and violation can bring penalties, generation restrictions or disconnection. The engineer carries a project from application through to Final Operational Notification with the system operator reviewing the work.
ROLE-0198.profile_source: researched: regulation and mandatory standards first, then professional bodies, then current job descriptions

ROLE-0196.name: Renewable Project Developer
ROLE-0196.note: Runs a project from site identification and fatal-flaw review through permitting and land agreements to financial close, managing consultants and supporting the consent process against contested local evidence.
ROLE-0196.profile_source: researched: regulation and mandatory standards first, then professional bodies, then current job descriptions

ROLE-0197.name: Renewable Operations Manager
ROLE-0197.note: Runs generation assets to availability and safety targets under a real-time control regime, coordinating maintenance against output.
ROLE-0197.profile_source: researched: regulation and mandatory standards first, then professional bodies, then current job descriptions
